about: c3 chorus edit (spec 2026-11-02 §5.3): one lip-sync take per pass, placed at the lag measured by motion-kit/tools/sync_check.py (sync = its sync.json, path relative to ep01/v2); an optional cutaway to a non-singing reused take from the vocal entry of lyric line at_line (timing/words.json, two frames early like build.py's vocal()) to the end of the pass. Lyrics stay on screen.

cutaway.why: 'I just looked outside' over her open eye: the look itself; S1v3 continues from the opening shot (light sweep gone by clip 4.0 s)
'I just looked outside' over her looking out of the window at the city: what 'outside' is, and a callback to 'It looked around' (S5 used clip 1.0-2.9 s)

rendered.note: the reviewed render used the c2-era chorus word times and, for B, cutaway entries 20.71 / 24.12 s; at_line with the measured words gives the same cut frames (620, 722)
